name: GLiNER adaptive HTTP extraction batch exchange

description.purpose: Machine-readable contract for consumers of the GLiNER HTTP adaptive batch inference exchange.
description.usage: POST /v1/extract/batch shares one schema and options across texts and returns one ordered result per text. JSON Schema is the executable shape/validation authority.
description.limitations: Inference probabilities are model outputs, not verified source facts. HTTP validates aggregate UTF-8 sizes and supported checkpoint schema separately.

schema.name: BatchExtractRequest
schema.description: Request JSON; authoritative constraints in http-extract-batch.schema.json.

properties.name: texts
properties.description: 1 to 64 nonempty document strings, max 16 KiB each and 64 KiB combined UTF-8.

schema.name: BatchExtractResponse
schema.description: Output preserves input order and model-specific structures.

properties.name: results
properties.description: One full extraction result per corresponding input document.
